patch.title: Mullum Organic Food Co-op
patch.description: Member-run community food co-op offering wholefoods and organic products where available. Volunteers run the shop inside Mullumbimby Community Garden, supporting access to local and affordable food. Check membership and shopping arrangements with the co-op.
patch.location_detail: Inside Mullumbimby Community Garden, at the bottom of Stuart Street, Mullumbimby NSW 2482

metadata.verificationNote: Opening hours differ between the co-op’s home and contact pages. Confirm current hours and shopping arrangements before visiting. This is the organic food co-op, not the Mullumbimby Rural Co-op.
metadata.source: Public-source review 2026-10-20; see source URLs and verification note.

patch.title: The Elder Tree Educational Medicine Garden
patch.description: Educational herb garden at the Mullum Gardens Eco-Hub in Mullumbimby. The organiser describes classes, workshops and volunteer working bees focused on growing and learning about herbs. Check current announcements for ways to take part.

metadata.verificationNote: Current working-bee dates, workshops and visitor access need confirmation. The garden page is undated and should not be treated as confirmation of current neighbouring nursery arrangements.
metadata.source: Public-source review 2026-10-20; see source URLs and verification note.

patch.title: Mullumbimby Men's Shed
patch.description: Community shed where people gather to make wooden items, repair things and share practical skills. The Australian Men’s Shed Association describes activities including furniture and toy repairs and making beehives. Contact the shed to confirm visiting and participation arrangements.

metadata.verificationNote: Address and phone are listed in the Australian Men’s Shed Association directory. The shed’s own website could not be reached during this check; confirm the contact details and current opening and membership arrangements. This is separate from Shedding Community Workshop at the Railway Shed.
metadata.source: Public-source review 2026-10-20; see source URLs and verification note.

patch.title: Generous Earth Co-operative
patch.description: Community-reported nursery initiative being established at Mullumbimby Community Garden. Its reported aim is to grow seedlings and cuttings for participating growers’ own projects. Public access, plant availability and ways to join are not yet confirmed.
patch.location_detail: Mullumbimby Community Garden, Mullumbimby — community-reported location; nursery access to be verified

metadata.verificationNote: Provisional community-reported listing. The name, location and current nursery arrangements have not been independently verified. No public website or contact has been confirmed. Please verify before visiting or relying on plant availability.
metadata.source: Community-submitted information received 2026-10-20; not independently verified.

patch.title: Mullum Library of Stuff
patch.description: Community lending library where members share equipment and other useful items instead of buying things they only need occasionally. Members help care for, share and repair the collection. The Library of Stuff website identifies it as a Mullum Cares project.
patch.location_detail: Blue brick shed on the south side of Mullumbimby Community Hall (formerly the Scout Hall), River Terrace, behind the post office, Mullumbimby

metadata.verificationNote: Check current opening sessions, membership commitments and item availability with the library. Its published location is on River Terrace, not at Mullumbimby Community Garden.
metadata.source: Public-source review 2026-10-20; see source URLs and verification note.

patch.title: Shedding Community Workshop (The Railway Shed)
patch.description: Community workshop at the Railway Shed in Mullumbimby, offering hands-on learning in tools, carpentry, building and repair. The organiser’s links include introductory workshops, community workdays and a Repair Cafe. Check the current programme and booking requirements through its official channels.
patch.location_detail: The Railway Shed, 18 Prince Street, Mullumbimby NSW 2482

metadata.verificationNote: Confirm current workshop dates and booking requirements through the organiser’s linked channels. Published phone numbers differ, so no phone number is listed here. Shedding is separate from Mullumbimby Men’s Shed at Stuart Street.
metadata.source: Public-source review 2026-10-20; see source URLs and verification note.
